# Markdown showcase

Every construct the post view renders: **bold**, *italic*, ***bold italic***,
~~struck~~, `inline code`, a [link](https://acp.us/rs "ACP"), an autolink
<https://example.org/docs>, a bare URL https://acp.us/rs/post/AZ7VnWW1fyumfmP-esjZig,
an escaped \*star\*, entities &amp; &copy; &mdash; and a footnote.[^plan]

## Lists

- Tight bullet item
- **Bold-led item** that is long enough to wrap onto a second line with a hanging indent
  - Nested bullet
    - Third level
1. First step
2. Second step
3. Third step

- [x] Task done
- [ ] Task open
